# Root help and store-independent commands remain usable without a store.
exec card --help
stdout '^Usage: card <command> \[flags\]'
exec card -h
stdout '^Usage: card <command> \[flags\]'
exec card -V
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/version.txt

# Explicit store selection remains lazy through help and parse failures.
exec card --store $WORK/missing --help
stdout '^Usage: card <command> \[flags\]'
! exists $WORK/missing
! exec card --store $WORK/missing list --bogus
stderr 'unknown flag --bogus'
! exists $WORK/missing

-- golden/version.txt --
dev go1.26.5
